note: Selection rule for shopper fusion weights and MMR lambda. Written before any judged score. Do not fill judgments in code. The test split is not an input.
selection: On validation personas only, choose the fusion weight that maximises mean graded NDCG@5. An exact tie breaks toward 0.5, then 0.25, then 0.75. Then take the largest lambda whose intra-list diversity gain over lambda 1 is positive and whose NDCG@5 loss is at most 0.02. Otherwise lambda stays 1.
freeze: configs/frozen.shopper.v1.json is written only by the tune script after the validation judgments pass ingest. It is not written from empty cells.
